summary: Verified the Platform Settings button bug fix on the Landing Page. Logged in as Super Admin (100001/admin123) - the 'Platform Settings' button (data-testid='header-platform-settings-btn') is visible in the header. Clicking it navigates to /platform-settings which shows all 4 tabs: Logos & Colors, Hero Slideshow, Login Background, Content & Text. Logged in as Battalion Chief (100002/bc123) - button is NOT visible, and direct URL access to /platform-settings is blocked (redirected to /dashboard with 'Access denied - Super Admin only' toast; backend returns 403). All 4 requested behaviors work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: WebSocket connection to wss://.../api/ws fails consistently in console (non-blocking, but noisy). Consider investigating.
Non-critical: Two 'Access denied - Super Admin only' toasts appear stacked when BC user directly hits /platform-settings (possibly duplicate fetch/redirect). Consider deduping.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Platform Settings header button fix verified end-to-end for Super Admin (visible + navigates) and BC (hidden + backend 403 on direct URL). All 4 tabs render on PlatformSettingsPage.
rca of the issue: Bug was that Platform Settings link only existed on the login page. Fix added the button to Landing Page header gated by isSuperAdmin && user check (LandingPage.js lines 137-160). Verified visually and via role-based conditional rendering.
